firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
I’ve mapped the rules and controls for the first levels of ARC-AGI-3 tasks to help everyone get their agents up and running faster. I'm actively extending this, but here is the initial breakdown.

[**Dataset**](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/karnakbaevarthur/arc-agi-3-all-tasks-explanation)

This is a work in progress and I’ll be adding more tasks regularly. Feedback and contributions are welcome. If you notice anything missing or have suggestions for improvements, drop a comment. I’m keeping this updated as we go!

**What's inside:**
* **Game Logic:** Short descriptions of the goal, primary mechanics, and game description.
* **Action Mapping:** A simple reference for what the 4 directional keys, "tap" and "special move" do in each environment.
* **Level-by-Level:** A quick guide on how rules and constraints evolve from Level 1 to 10.

**How to use this:**
* **LLM Grounding:** Feed these text explanations to your LLM so it "understands" the rules before acting on the grid.
* **Pattern Matching:** Use the metadata to group similar problems (e.g., tasks that share gravity or mirroring logic).
* **Task Routing:** Help your agent select the right solver based on the task description.

[Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/karnakbaevarthur/arc-agi-3-all-tasks-explanation)

Good luck :)
